away.summary: The Golden Knights (9-5-1) are coming off a 5-2 loss to New Jersey and have dropped three of their last four games. Carter Hart is projected to start after missing the previous two games with a lower-body injury, while Adin Hill is listed as the backup. Victor Olofsson and Parker Wotherspoon are injured, and Raphael Lavoie and Viliam Kmec are scratched.

returning: detail: will play after being scratched for the 5-4 overtime win against Chicago on Saturday; replaces Sean Kuraly on the fourth line
home.summary: The Bruins (10-4-1) are coming off a 5-4 overtime comeback win against Chicago and have won two straight after a loss to St. Louis. Jeremy Swayman is projected to start in net, with Michael DiPietro as backup. Matthew Poitras returns to the lineup after being scratched Saturday, while Connor Clifton, Sean Kuraly, and Frederic Brunet are scratched.
